# netbox_vlan_translation_policy (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/ipam/vlantranslationpolicy/):

> A VLAN translation policy groups the rules that map local VLAN IDs to remote VLAN IDs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_vlan_translation_policy" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the vlan translation policy.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the vlan translation policy.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the vlan translation policy.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the vlan translation policy.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_vlan_translation_policy.example 1
```
